Andrew,

There is a function showUsage() in the rsconnect/shinyapps package that can be used to get the number of hours used. We currently don't have a similar function for application level metrics (connections, cpu, memory, etc).

-Andy

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Is there a way to get access to my usage metrics
parts:
On Wed, Mar 2, 2016 at 12:34 PM, Andrew Clark <scott.r...@gmail.com> wrote:
Thanks Andy

That function works fine
showUsage(appDir = getwd(), appName = NULL, account = NULL,
  server = NULL, usageType = "hours", from = NULL, until = NULL,
  interval = NULL)

Couple of points
 a) Is there a list of usageType and relative time delta options

We only have 'hours' right now. We don't track other account usage types as this time. 

We have the following relative time delta's defined (as seconds):

{"s": 1, "m": 60, "h": 3600, "d": 86400, "w": 604800}

b) If I use the NULL value for from, I get 2 values for most hours (one of them being zero) and the data goes back just a month
. If I enter a value e.g. from=1446938000, the data goes back further but an hours return is just shown once a day 16:00:00

You can use the interval parameter to change the aggregation window. For example if you want to look at one month of metrics by hour you would use interval="1h". If the interval parameter is not specified it attempts to guess a reasonable default to reduce data points returned.
c) Just to clarify, the time returned is for when the app is being used (or at least is not inactive) by at least one person. It could be more but this data is not available, right?

Actually if you upgrade to the latest version of rsconnect from GitHub, I just added a new 'showMetrics' function last week. It works similarly as showUsage, and is also poorly documented:

# from your application directory
metrics.connections <- showMetrics("container.shiny.connections", "shiny.connections.active")
metrics.cpu <- showMetrics("container.cpu", c("cpu.user", "cpu.system"))
metrics.mem <- showMetrics("container.memory", c("memory.total_rss", "memory.total_cache"))

tx
